title: Ext continuity for constructible etale modules in affine inverse limits
statement:
Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed set and $(X_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated Noetherian schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$, with projections $f_i$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and fix $i\in I$ and constructible sheaves $P_i,Q_i$ of $A$-modules on $(X_i)_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. For $j\geq i$, write $P_j,Q_j$ for their exact inverse images and $P,Q$ for their inverse images on $X$. For every integer $n\geq0$, the canonical map
$$\varinjlim_{j\geq i}\operatorname{Ext}^n_{(X_j)_{\mathrm{et}},A}(P_j,Q_j)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Ext}^n_{X_{\mathrm{et}},A}(P,Q)$$
is an isomorphism. Here $\operatorname{Ext}^n(P,Q)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(-_{\mathrm{et}},A)}(P,Q[n])$ in the ordinary module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The maps are induced by inverse image, and commute with composition of derived morphisms and with passage to later stages. No projectivity, local constancy, or finite-Tor condition on $P_i$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09YU, lemma-category-is-colimit (constructible module descent and full faithfulness), and Tag 0GIT, lemma-colimit-complexes (cohomology continuity). Agent Ext-continuity extension using finite constructible presentations and finite-degree resolutions; these tags are the inputs, not a claim that 0GIT itself states Ext continuity.
